question.original: I am building a course on operational excellence. Here is the Learner Requirement Document: https://businessdatasolutions.github.io/operational-excellence-course/design-documents/lrd-operational-excellence.html . Can you crawl the ai wiki and make a list of topics/concepts/business cases that will be valuable to the course?
question.restated: Which wiki pages (concepts, sources/business-cases, syntheses) supply valuable content for a HAN Operational Excellence course structured around the Direct/Design/Deliver/Develop operations cycle, with a mandatory Lean 4.0 / Industry 5.0 critical lens and a DMAIC capstone?
facets: Direct-phase strategy and digital-transformation framing (operations strategy, dynamic capabilities)
Design/Deliver-phase process, technology and Lean content (Industry 4.0/5.0, Lean 4.0, industrial AI)
Develop-phase improvement, quality and change-management content (systems thinking/TQM/Six Sigma/BPR, resistance-as-data, org design)
Cross-cutting business cases and the DMAIC/critical-lens capstone material

Gomaa (2025) 'Lean 4.0: A Strategic Roadmap for Operational Excellence and Innovation in Smart Manufacturing' is the literal paper the LRD's Ch14-15 and DMAIC capstone reference
Micro-productivity trap names planning-and-control value leakage (offering lock-in / process lock-in)
Ontology-driven data fabric is the process-technology substrate for industrial AI agents
Heineken Mexico changeover case (6h to 15min, +1M cases/month) is a quantified Deliver-phase capacity/OEE business case
